On this page
PATCH Connection Settings

Change your NinjaTrader connection settings. Send only the parts you want to change. Arrays (autoReconnect, dataWatchdog, groups, relatedProducts, accounts) replace the saved array as a whole.

ELITE

The Management API requires an Elite subscription. See Authentication.

Endpoint​

PATCH https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connection-settings

Headers​
NAME	REQUIRED	VALUE
Authorization	Yes	Bearer <your API token>
Content-Type	Yes	application/json
If-Match	No	ETag from a previous read
Body parameters​
NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	CONSTRAINTS	DESCRIPTION
autoReconnect	array of {connection, enabled, timeoutSeconds}	No	At most 50, connection names unique, timeoutSeconds 10 to 3600	Auto-reconnect per connection
dataWatchdog	array of {connection, enabled, timeoutSeconds}	No	Same as above	Data watchdog per connection
reconnectActions.restartStrategies	boolean	No		Restart strategies after a reconnect
reconnectActions.flatten.scope	none, all, strategy_accounts, specific	No	Needs add-on v1.13 or newer	Which accounts to flatten after a reconnect
reconnectActions.flatten.accounts	array of account names	No	Required when scope is specific, empty otherwise. At most 200, unique	Accounts to flatten
opposingPositionProtection.enabled	boolean	No		Turn the protection on or off
opposingPositionProtection.checkAllAccounts	boolean	No		Compare positions across all your accounts
opposingPositionProtection.relatedProducts	"default" or array of [SYMBOL, SYMBOL]	No	At most 200 pairs; two different symbols per pair	"default" saves the current CrossTrade default list
opposingPositionProtection.groups	array of {name, accounts, relatedProducts?}	No	At most 50, names unique, 1 to 200 unique accounts each. A group's relatedProducts is an array of pairs or null (not "default")	Account groups checked together

opposingPositionProtection.relatedProductsSource is read-only. You can send back the whole object from GET Connection Settings: a relatedProductsSource equal to the saved value is ignored.

Code examples​
Python
cURL
import requests



resp = requests.patch(

    "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connection-settings",

    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"},

    json={"reconnectActions": {"flatten": {"scope": "specific", "accounts": ["Sim101"]}}},

)

print(resp.json())

Responses​
200
422
Other errors
{

  "success": true,

  "changed": true,

  "data": {

    "autoReconnect": [],

    "dataWatchdog": [],

    "reconnectActions": { "restartStrategies": false, "flatten": { "scope": "specific", "accounts": ["Sim101"] } },

    "opposingPositionProtection": {

      "enabled": false, "checkAllAccounts": false,

      "relatedProducts": [["ES", "MES"]], "relatedProductsSource": "custom", "groups": []

    }

  },

  "changedFields": ["reconnectActions.flatten.accounts", "reconnectActions.flatten.scope"],

  "delivery": { "status": "queued", "target": "nt8_addon" },

  "warnings": [],

  "meta": { "requestId": "req_9f2c1a0b7d3e4f51", "etag": "\"c2:Tm90UmVhbEV0YWcwMg\"" }

}

When it takes effect​

The settings are sent to the add-on right after the save (delivery.status: "queued"). If the add-on is offline ("pending_connection"), it receives them when it next connects. The add-on needs v1.12 or newer to receive them.

Notes​
If your add-on is connected but older than v1.13 and reconnectActions.flatten.scope is not none, the response carries an addon_version_unsupported warning: older add-ons ignore the flatten setting.
A connection or account name you add is checked against your NinjaTrader, so adding one needs the add-on connected. Names already saved are not re-checked, so other changes work while the add-on is offline.
flatten merges like any object, so the saved accounts stay when you change only scope. To move away from specific, send "accounts": [] with the new scope, or the request fails with only_for_specific_scope.
